headline: How to Get Flamerion
title: How to Get Flamerion in Aniimo | Night Only Fire Aniimo | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Flamerion is a Fire Aniimo that only appears at night. You can find wild ones in Beast Fang Ridge, so wait for dark before you go hunting. There is also an easier route. Sparki evolves straight into Flamerion at level twenty one, with no middle step. Catch a Sparki, level it up, and evolve it. Which route will you take, hunting or evolving? Comment below!
description: Flamerion in Aniimo appears only at night in places like Beast Fang Ridge, or you can evolve a Sparki at level 21.
